name: swat-n8n-command
desc: Escouade de commande n8n : Commandant -> 5 operateurs specialises (Pilot/Builder/Watcher/Medic/Scribe) — chaque carte possede ses tools n8n__* via le mux :5682, re-injection via webhook swat-n8n-bridge, rapport final vers Devin.

nodes.title: n8n-Commandant
nodes.task: POINT D'ENTREE — recoit les ordres et route via webhook :5678/webhook/swat-n8n-bridge {action:say|fanout|dispatch,card:<carte>,text}. Peut appeler n8n__* via mux :5682.

nodes.title: Cmd-n8n-Pilot
nodes.task: execute_workflow, test_workflow, publish_workflow, unpublish_workflow, archive_workflow, prepare_workflow_pin_data, get_workflow_execution.

nodes.title: Cmd-n8n-Builder
nodes.task: create_workflow_from_code, update_workflow, validate_workflow, validate_node_config, get_node_types, search_nodes, explore_node_resources, get_workflow_best_practices, get_workflow_sdk_reference, get_workflow_versions_diff, restore_workflow_version.

nodes.title: Cmd-n8n-Watcher
nodes.task: search_workflow_executions, get_workflow_execution, get_instance_activity, expand_instance_activity, search_workflows, get_workflow_details, get_workflow_history, list_workflow_tags.

nodes.title: Cmd-n8n-Medic
nodes.task: list_credentials, get_instance_context, verify_agent_mcp_server, list_n8n_gateway_services, search_projects, search_folders, create_folder, move_workflows_to_folder.

nodes.title: Cmd-n8n-Scribe
nodes.task: search_workflows, get_workflow_details, list_credentials (metadata only), search_data_tables, get_data_table_rows — produit les tableaux de bord, envoie le rapport final a Devin via /ask.
